probes.probe: raw-probability check: top option-token probability vs request temperature (server check, not a matrix cell)

request.seed: request_seed(1, item_id, 'first') per item, identical across temperatures

items.selection: every 10th item of run_cell.load_teleqna(TeleQnA.txt, 1500) in frame order

probes.redaction: TeleQnA rows: question ids replaced by the salted pseudonyms of the released data (the same keyed pseudonyms as experiments/; each id occurs in the redacted first-pass caches under experiments/cache/), request seeds and option labels removed (sampled_is_top keeps whether the sampled token was the top option), row order shuffled; probabilities unchanged. Rows whose retained values are identical (same category and same probabilities at every temperature) carry interchangeable ids, so the file does not fix which of them is which
